user_message: I don't know if I'm proud of anything, to be honest. I mean, I thought I was doing okay, thought I was a good partner, thought I was a good person. But now I'm starting to wonder if that was just an illusion. Maybe I was just deluding myself into thinking I was good enough, and it was all just a facade. And even if I was good, does it matter? Because in the end, my partner still left me, still stopped talking to me, still made me feel like I'm worthless. So, what's the point of being proud of anything? It's not like it's going to change anything. And besides, what's there to be proud of? I'm still stuck in this rut, still can't sleep, still can't shake off these awful feelings. Maybe I'm just a failure, and I'll never be able to move on from this. Maybe I'll just be stuck in this misery forever.
